{{nihongo|'''Hashiriochi Shrine'''|走落神社 (長浜市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

'''Hashiriochi Shrine''' (はしりおちじんじゃ / はせおちじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} enshrined in {{ill|Nagahama, Shiga|Q844130|qid=Q844130}}, {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|Q131358|qid=Q131358}}. It is an {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Engishiki inner shrine}}.

===History===
It is said to have been founded in the {{ill|Jinki (era)|Q1373210|qid=Q1373210}} era ({{ill|724|Q23549|qid=Q23549}}-{{ill|729|Q23561|qid=Q23561}}).<br />
It is also said that {{ill|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|af|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|ar|تويوتومي هيده-يوشي|arz|تويوتومى هيده يوشى|ast|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|az|Toyotomi Hideyoşi|ban|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|be|Таётомі Хідэёсі|bg|Тойотоми Хидейоши|ca|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|cdo|Hŭng-sìng Séu-gék|ckb|تۆیۆتۆمی ھیدێیۆشی|cs|Hidejoši Tojotomi|de|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|el|Τογιοτόμι Χιντεγιόσι|eo|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|es|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|et|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|eu|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|fa|تویوتومی هیده‌یوشی|fi|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|fr|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|gl|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|glk|تویوتومی هیده یوشی|hak|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|he|טויוטומי הידיושי|hr|Tojotomi Hidejoši|hu|Tojotomi Hidejosi|hy|Տոյոտոմի Հիդեյոսի|ia|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|id|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|is|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|it|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|ja|豊臣秀吉|ka|ტოიოტომი ჰიდეიოსი|kk|Тоётоми Хидэёси|ko|도요토미 히데요시|kw|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|la|Taicosama|lt|Tojotomi Hidejoši|lv|Tojotomi Hidejosi|mg|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|ml|തൊയൊത്തോമി ഹിദെയോഷി|ms|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|nl|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|no|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|oc|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|pl|Hideyoshi Toyotomi|pt|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|ro|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|ru|Тоётоми Хидэёси|sc|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|sco|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|simple|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|sk|Hidejoši Tojotomi|sl|Tojotomi Hidejoši|sq|Tojotomi Hidejoshi|sr|Тојотоми Хидејоши|sv|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|tg|Тайетоми Хидзеси|th|โทโยโตมิ ฮิเดโยชิ|tl|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|tr|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|uk|Тойотомі Хідейосі|ur|تویوتومی ہیدیئوشی|vi|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|war|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|wuu|丰臣秀吉|zh|丰臣秀吉|zh_classical|豐臣秀吉|zh_min_nan|Toyotomi Hideyosi|zh_yue|豐臣秀吉|zu|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|qid=Q187550}}, heading for the {{ill|Battle of Shizugatake|Q225562|qid=Q225562}} in {{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|Q1145058|qid=Q1145058}} 11 ({{ill|1583|Q6726|qid=Q6726}}), dismounted before the shrine {{ill|Torii|Q234731|qid=Q234731}} and prayed for victory.<br />
In {{ill|Tenmei|Q1194121|qid=Q1194121}} 7 ({{ill|1787|Q7763|qid=Q7763}}), it suffered a great fire, and shrine buildings and all held documents were destroyed.<br />
In {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 9 ({{ill|1876|Q7766|qid=Q7766}}), it was ranked {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}, and in Meiji 41 ({{ill|1908|Q2056|qid=Q2056}}) it was designated a {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=shinsen-heihaku-ryō kyōshin-sha}}.
